text:
One slow third-party API took my whole app down with it.

That failure mode has a name: cascading failure. And it's preventable.

Reliability patterns that actually show up in production:

• Redundancy — no single box on the critical path
• Timeouts + circuit breakers — fail fast instead of pile up
• Graceful degradation — ship a partial response, not a 500
• Bulkheads — isolate failures so one tenant doesn't sink the fleet

Fault tolerance isn't optimism. It's assuming things break and designing for it.
